description: COVID-19 Reported Patient Impact and Hospital Capacity by State Timeseries is published by U.S. Department of Health & Human Services. The archive aggregates reported COVID-19 patient impact and hospital capacity by state. Its stated coverage is United States; state-level time series through May 2024. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain U.S. Government. Updates ended after 3 May 2024 when mandatory reporting changed. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
